**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g. *I need detection for QR-code phishing / Quishing*).

If this involves new threat signals, NLP transformers, or SOC workflow changes, outline the proposed logic.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, diagrams, or references here.
